fixtures.title: Synthetic Republic Act No. 1001
fixtures.content:
Synthetic Republic Act No. 1001

Section 1. This Act establishes a synthetic legal-research obligation for covered entities.

Section 2. A covered entity must register with the synthetic authority before it begins operations.

Section 3. The synthetic authority may issue implementing rules consistent with this Act.

Section 4. A violation of Section 2 is subject to a synthetic administrative penalty.

Synthetic Republic Act No. 1001

Section 1. This Act establishes a synthetic legal-research obligation for covered entities.

Section 2. A covered entity must register with the synthetic authority and renew its registration every year.

Section 3. The synthetic authority may issue implementing rules consistent with this Act.

Section 4. A violation of Section 2 is subject to a synthetic administrative penalty.

fixtures.title: Synthetic Entity v. Synthetic Authority
fixtures.content:
Synthetic Entity v. Synthetic Authority

Facts. The covered entity operated without registering.

Issue. Whether registration is required before operations begin.

Ruling. A covered entity must register with the synthetic authority before it begins operations. The obligation is mandatory and precedes commencement.

Dispositive. The petition is denied.

fixtures.title: Synthetic Cooperative v. Synthetic Authority
fixtures.content:
Synthetic Cooperative v. Synthetic Authority

Facts. A cooperative registered late but before operating.

Issue. Whether late registration cures the Section 2 requirement.

Ruling. A covered entity must register with the synthetic authority before it begins operations; registration after operations begin does not cure the defect. This distinguishes G.R. No. 999001 on its facts.

Dispositive. The petition is denied.

Rule 2. A covered entity must submit a registration form to the synthetic authority.
